items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: And there was Vaughn Monroe. I mean all of those people were the pop people, yeah.

ctx.x: I don’t know. I just remember when I first started walking around New York by myself, before I even went to high school, I came in the summer, “I’m looking Over a Four Leaf Clover” was coming out of every little storefront. That was the thing. And of course well I mean Frank Sinatra, you know, a lot of people think he’s a jazz singer, I think he’s a © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-
very good singer but I don’t really put him as a jazz singer. But that may be just my particular taste. And there was Vaughn Monroe. I mean all of those people were the pop people, yeah.
